test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 03
subject: general
question: Seven students A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row. G sits between A and E. One more student sits between F and A. Two students sit between E and C. D sits immediate right of F. Three students sit between C and B. Who is sitting in the middle?
solution:
Six People- A, B, C, D, E, F and G

D sits immediate right of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27af47a1caa58ada3026c120daf6929c2b1bd2ccdcaef29c8cb25fb83708889a.png] 

 One more student sits between F and A. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86e5bd5a60ecee4934620f85f22d4570b3d3b0958466367b1e981236a5501647.png] 

G sits between A and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d02fe19a0ae5c0d3fb1973d827626297b59a32717f37734d8026efebe9561cb4.png] 

Two students sit between E and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71fccc70cbe7457607db9d2ade7a8b0821025bb66843a396da6d37533dbfd2a0.png] 

Three students sit between C and B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ac67644a5c42d294dbddc519ac03dfd13fe36f9b3e22d66239ca446347aa50e.png] 

Hence, the correct option is **A.**
